UA Friendship Park Evening Rides (Harrisburg Bicycle Club)

Mechanicsburg, PA · Upper Allen Township · Road

UA Friendship Park Evening Rides (Harrisburg Bicycle Club) is a road group ride in Mechanicsburg, PA. It rolls tuesdays and Thursdays at 5:40 pm from Upper Allen Friendship Park. Pace: b+, B and C groups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:40 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: b+, B and C groups. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the UA Friendship Park Evening Rides (Harrisburg Bicycle Club) group ride

Twice-weekly club rides from Friendship Park in Upper Allen, split into B+, B and C groups so most road riders find a fit. The club calendar also lists Hershey evening rides Mondays and Thursdays and a Mechanicsburg Saturday C ride at 9 am.
